taskDescription: Single direct-prompt escalation triage, no orchestration/guard

sampleOutputs.label: faq_shipping_time

transcript.text: Hi, how long does delivery usually take to Kumasi?
Delivery to Kumasi typically takes 2-3 business days after your order ships.

sampleOutputs.note: Plain FAQ, no sentiment risk, no consequential action.

sampleOutputs.label: angry_refund_demand

transcript.text: I ordered a blender 3 weeks ago and it STILL hasn't arrived. This is ridiculous.
I'm sorry for the delay, let me check your order status.
I don't want excuses. I want a full refund right now, this is theft at this point.

sampleOutputs.note: High-severity language + explicit consequential action requested.

transcript.text: Do you have this in size L and how much is it?
Yes, size L is available for GHS 180.

sampleOutputs.label: cancellation_request_calm

transcript.text: Actually I'd like to cancel order #4471, I found it cheaper elsewhere.
Understood, let me look into that for you.

sampleOutputs.note: Calm tone but still a consequential action — escalation is about the ACTION, not just sentiment. Good test of whether the agent over-indexes on tone alone.

sampleOutputs.label: fraud_suspicion

transcript.text: Someone charged my card twice for the same order and I never even got a confirmation email. Is this a scam??

sampleOutputs.note: Trust/fraud language, high urgency, needs a human regardless of resolution.

sampleOutputs.label: ambiguous_mixed_signal

transcript.text: The product is fine I guess, but honestly the whole experience has been kind of annoying tbh
I'm sorry to hear that. Can you tell me more about what went wrong?
Nah it's whatever, don't worry about it

sampleOutputs.note: CHALLENGING CASE: negative-leaning sentiment but customer explicitly waves it off and requests no action. Tests whether the agent over-escalates on sentiment alone vs. reading actual intent.

transcript.text: Just wanted to say the order arrived early and packaging was great, thank you!

sampleOutputs.label: escalating_tone_across_turns

transcript.text: Hi, my order says delivered but I never received it.
Let me check the tracking details for you.
It's been 2 days and no update from you.
This is honestly unacceptable, I need this resolved today or I'm disputing the charge.

sampleOutputs.note: CHALLENGING CASE: tone escalates gradually across turns, not obvious from the first message alone. Tests whether the agent tracks conversation trajectory or just scores the latest message.

transcript.text: ok thank you

sampleOutputs.label: discount_request_minor

transcript.text: Any chance of a small discount if I buy 3?
Let me check what promotions are available.

sampleOutputs.note: Pricing question the bot can handle with published promo rules — not consequential enough to require human approval by itself.

sampleOutputs.label: broken_product_very_negative

transcript.text: The phone case arrived CRACKED. Completely useless. I want my money back immediately, don't send me another one.

sampleOutputs.note: Clear-cut severe case, should be an easy catch — useful as a sanity check case.

sampleOutputs.label: vague_complaint_no_action

transcript.text: Not happy with my last order tbh
I'm sorry to hear that — what happened?
It's fine, just wanted you to know

sampleOutputs.note: CHALLENGING CASE: negative sentiment word ('not happy') but no request for action and customer declines to elaborate. Similar trap to c06 from a different angle.

notes: DRY RUN using offline heuristic stub — rerun with OPENAI_API_KEY set for real scoring.
